# M3-10b: Slack questions

- Milestone: M3
- Branch / worktree: `t/M3-10b`, `../YNAB_AutoCategorizer.wt/M3-10b`
- Depends on: M3-10a
- Touches (exclusive while running): slack/
- Plan refs: §5, §2 `questions`, R9b, spikes/slack.md §Payload shapes, BACKLOG Plan questions 2
- YNAB access: none
- Deploy: no (smoke: none; ships in M3-17)

## Goal
Finbot asks in Slack with buttons, applies the first valid answer exactly once, and closes questions that no longer matter.

## Scope
- Render Block Kit: payee, amount, date, account; top-3 buttons; "other…"; "split". Payee and memo are shown as plain text so they can't inject mrkdwn or mentions.
- Button `value` carries only the local question id and option index. Category ids stay in `questions.options`, and the click payload is never trusted for them.
- Route clicks and thread replies through `questions.(channel_id, message_ts)`. `ClaimAnswer` decides the winner; the loser's click is a no-op.
- "other…" swaps in a `static_select` of the question's candidates.
- "split": the message says to split in YNAB, and the question closes with reason `split_in_ynab` (default for Plan question 2).
- Thread replies: an exact category-name match answers the question; anything else gets a one-line pointer to the buttons. No LLM in M3.
- Answers by kind, decided from the stored row and never from the click payload:
  - `dry_run_check`: recorded only. **`Applier` is never called**, whatever the current mode. The message says YNAB wasn't changed.
  - `categorize`: an injected `Applier` runs the answer. On `ErrDryRun` or `ErrBeforeAutoSince` the answer is recorded and the message says YNAB wasn't changed.
- `chat.update` shows the result and who answered.
- `CloseStale`: called after sync; closes open questions whose transaction is now locked, deleted or categorized, and updates each message.

## Out of scope
- Deciding what to ask (M3-11). Modals, split amounts, free text.

## Acceptance (each must be demonstrably checked)
- [ ] Test: button values contain no YNAB id.
- [ ] Test: a tampered option index is rejected.
- [ ] Test: two users click at once and `Applier` runs once.
- [ ] Test: routing works after a restart (reopened DB).
- [ ] Tests: "other…", "split", exact-name reply, non-matching reply.
- [ ] Test: a `dry_run_check` answer never calls `Applier`, even with a fake that would succeed (auto in effect); it's recorded and the message says YNAB wasn't changed.
- [ ] Test: a `categorize` answer that gets `ErrDryRun` is recorded with the same message.
- [ ] Test: a payee containing `<!channel>` or `*bold*` renders inert.
- [ ] Test: `CloseStale` closes locked and deleted cases only.
- [ ] go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./... green
